title: Premium Multi-Purpose Pet Carrier for Small to Medium Pets
description:
This carrier is built to be the one bag that works for almost any trip, whether that's a quick dash to the vet, a weekend visit to family, or a longer day out together. It suits small to medium dogs, cats, rabbits and other similarly sized pets, so it's a genuinely useful option if you have more than one type of pet at home or simply want something versatile.

The main compartment is generously padded along the base, which takes the edge off bumpy pavements and car journeys alike, while mesh panels on three sides keep air moving so your pet doesn't feel closed in. A top-loading zip opening sits alongside the usual front entry, which makes a real difference when you're trying to settle a nervous pet in without a struggle.

We've also thought about you, not just your pet. A padded, adjustable shoulder strap and a sturdy top carry handle mean you can switch grips depending on the day, and the whole thing folds flat when it's empty so it doesn't take up much room between trips. The zips are backed with a safety clip, so there's no risk of an unexpected escape mid-journey.

Inside, a removable cushioned liner lifts out for washing, which matters more than it sounds once you've had a long car journey or an accident to deal with. The frame keeps its shape even when packed for a longer trip, so your pet always has a stable, level base to settle onto.

This is a demonstration product listing, added to show how a full product page looks on Pet Carrier. Real products will be added via the admin panel once the store goes live.

title: Feandrea Foldable Travel Crate for Dogs and Cats, 60cm, Grey
description:
## About the Feandrea Foldable Travel Crate

The Feandrea Foldable Travel Crate is a soft-sided carrier for pet owners who want something sturdier than a simple bag-style carrier but still easy to fold away between trips. A lightweight steel frame keeps its shape while your pet is inside, and the whole crate collapses flat to roughly 60cm x 42cm x 8cm when you are done, so it tucks into a car boot or cupboard without taking up permanent space.

It suits [small dogs](/carriers/dog-carriers/small-dog-carriers) in the 7 to 11kg range, as well as cats who prefer a roomier, more open carrier than a hard box style. Because it opens out into a proper crate shape rather than a narrow bag, pets have enough room to turn around, lie down and settle in for longer journeys.

## Key Features

### Steel Frame with Fold-Flat Design

A metal frame supports the 600D Oxford fabric body, so the crate holds its shape properly while your pet is inside rather than collapsing in on them. Once you are finished, unclip the frame and it folds flat for storage.

### Mesh Doors and Windows

Mesh panels run along the doors and windows, giving your dog or cat a good view out and steady airflow. This also helps nervous pets feel less shut in, since they can see you are close by.

### Storage Pockets

Two side pockets built into the crate hold small items such as a lead, treats or a water bottle, so there is no need to carry a separate bag for short trips.

### Removable Base Mat

A soft, easy-clean mat lines the base for comfort. Lift it out between uses to keep the crate fresh.

## Who This Crate Is Best For

This [dog carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers) and [cat carrier](/carriers/cat-carriers) suits:

- Small to medium dogs weighing roughly 7 to 11kg (Toy Poodles, Corgis, French Bulldogs and similar breeds)
- Cats who prefer more room to move than a hard box-style carrier
- [Car journeys](/carriers/car-travel-carriers) and [vet visits](/carriers/vet-visit-carriers), thanks to the fold-flat storage
- Camping trips, hotel stays or as an occasional indoor den at home
- Owners who want a [soft-sided carrier](/carriers/soft-sided-carriers) that still holds its shape properly

## Care Instructions

Wipe down the fabric exterior with a damp cloth. Lift out the base mat to shake off loose hair and spot clean as needed. Let everything dry fully before folding away, to stop any musty smell developing in storage.
short_description: A soft-sided, foldable travel crate for small to medium dogs and cats, built around a steel frame with breathable mesh panels. Folds flat for easy storage and opens out again in seconds for car journeys, camping trips or a cosy spot at home.

title: Lionto Foldable Dog Crate for Travel and Car, 60cm, Grey
description:
## About the Lionto Foldable Dog Crate

The Lionto Foldable Dog Crate is a fabric and steel-tube crate designed for car travel, house training and everyday resting at home. Oxford fabric stretched over a lightweight steel frame keeps the crate stable while your dog is inside, and it folds down flat when you do not need it, so it does not take up permanent floor space.

A padded reclining cushion with a removable cover lines the base, giving your dog a comfortable spot to settle whether you are on a long drive or they are having a quiet nap at home. Because the crate keeps its shape and has a defined sleeping area, it also works well as part of house training, since most puppies avoid soiling the space they sleep in.

## Key Features

### Steel Tube Frame

Durable, lightweight steel tubes support the fabric body, so the crate holds its shape properly rather than sagging once your dog climbs in.

### Mesh Windows and Zip Access

Mesh netting on the sides and front gives good airflow and lets your dog see out, while zips at the top and front make it easy to get them in and out.

### Padded Cushion Base

A cosy reclining cushion with a removable cover sits inside the base. Take it out to freshen up between uses.

### Fold-Flat Storage

When you do not need the crate, it folds flat for easy storage in a car boot, cupboard or under a bed.

### Carry Handle and Side Pockets

A sturdy carry handle makes it easy to move between the car and the house, and two side pockets hold small items like treats or a lead.

## Who This Crate Is Best For

This [dog carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers) suits:

- Small to medium dogs who need a stable, comfortable crate for car journeys
- Puppies going through house training, thanks to the defined sleeping area
- Owners who want a [car travel](/carriers/car-travel-carriers) crate that doubles as an everyday resting spot at home
- Trips to the [vet](/carriers/vet-visit-carriers) or short stays away from home
- Anyone who wants a crate that folds away flat rather than a rigid plastic carrier taking up storage space

## Care Instructions

Remove the cushion cover and wash it separately according to its care label. Wipe the fabric shell with a damp cloth and let everything dry fully before folding the crate away for storage.

title: Dog Car Carrier LightWeight 68.5x52x52cm, Foldable Dog Carrier, Green
description:
## About This Foldable Dog Car Carrier

This foldable dog car carrier is built around a steel wire frame with a PP honeycomb top board and honeycomb bottom pad, giving it a sturdy structure that resists collapsing while staying light. At around 2.6kg (5.7lbs), it is noticeably lighter than a typical iron frame transport cage of the same size, which makes it easier to carry to and from the car.

It measures approximately 61 x 45 x 52cm internally, giving a small to medium dog room to sit, turn around, and settle in comfortably.

## Key Features

### Indoor and Outdoor Use

Doubles as a cat house or dog crate at home, a secured pet seat in the car, or an outdoor pet tent. The [foldable dog carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers) design means it packs away flat when not needed, rather than taking up permanent space.

### Breathable, Private Design

Three sided roller blinds combine with four sided nylon mesh panelling to give privacy, sunshade, and rain protection while still keeping air moving, so your dog does not feel stuffy or exposed inside.

### Secure Car Fixings

Designed for [car travel](/carriers/car-travel-carriers), with lockable zippers and safety belt fixings that keep your dog secured to the seat rather than sliding around during the journey.

### Easy to Clean

The bottom cushion and foot pads are removable and washable, and the base fabric wipes clean, so everyday mess from muddy paws or travel accidents is straightforward to deal with.

## Specifications

- Internal dimensions: approximately 61cm x 45cm x 52cm
- Weight when empty: approximately 2.6kg (5.7lbs)
- Frame: steel wire with PP honeycomb top board and honeycomb base
- Colour: Green
- Use: indoor crate, car travel carrier, outdoor pet tent
